note:
Hi love,
I can't believe you're 17 now - I still remember the 14 year old baby I met in 11th during tall tales. 
Anyways, you're growing up so fast and into such a wonderful person, I can't help but feel proud of you. You're empathetic, charming, intelligent and so much more that I cant put into words. (Ik this is cheesy, deal with it)
We may not be sisters by blood but you're the sibling I've wanted my whole life (yes, I tell everyone you're my sister. No I dont tell them we're not related by blood.)
I can't wait to see the trajectory your life takes - whatever it is; I'll always be proud of you.
Take it slow and know that you're never alone. Remember that you're an incredibly intelligent person who's strong enough to deal with all the shit that's thrown at her; and for the times you don't feel as strong, call me - I'll remind you. 
I'm always here for you - no matter what it is and when you call. 
I adore the person you are and who you're growing up to become.
I miss you and love you more everyday. 

Love, Tamanna
